name: Human Necromancer 10 (CR 9)
body:
HUMAN NECROMANCER 10
CR 9

XP 6,400
Human necromancer 10
CE Medium humanoid (human)
Init +0; Senses lifesight (see below); Perception +2

DEFENSE

AC 10, touch 10, flat-footed 10
hp 42 (10d6)
Fort +5, Ref +5, Will +13

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee unarmed strike +4 (1d3–1)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 10th; melee touch +4, ranged touch +5):

9/day—grave touch

Spells Prepared (CL 10th; melee touch +4, ranged touch +5):

5th—magic jar (DC 21), magic jar (DC 21)B, teleport, waves of fatigue
4th—fear (DC 20), fear (DC 20)B, scrying (DC 20), wall of ice (DC 20)
3rd—deep slumber (DC 19), fly x2, magic circle against good, ray of exhaustion (DC 19)B
2nd—blindness/deafness (DC 18), detect thoughts (DC 18), ghoul touch (DC 18)B, invisibility, mirror image, spectral hand x2
1st—comprehend languages, mage armor, magic missile, protection from good, ray of enfeeblement (DC 17), ray of enfeeblement (DC 17)B
0 (at will)—bleed (DC 16), detect magic, light

Arcane School necromancy; Opposition Schools enchantment, evocation

STATISTICS

Str 9, Dex 10, Con 11, Int 23, Wis 15, Cha 10
Base Atk +5; CMB +4; CMD 14
Feats Craft WandB, Craft Wondrous ItemB, Deceitful, Extend Spell, Improved Counterspell, Improved Iron Will, Iron Will, Scribe ScrollB, Spell Mastery (ghoul touch, fly, mage armor, magic jar, magic missile, teleport), Turn Undead (9/day, DC 15)
Skills Appraise +13, Bluff +8, Craft (alchemy) +12, Diplomacy +2, Disguise +2, Fly +7, Intimidate +6, Knowledge (arcana) +19, Knowledge (geography) +14, Knowledge (history) +14, Knowledge (nature) +13, Knowledge (planes) +15, Knowledge (religion) +14, Linguistics +12, Sense Motive +6, Spellcraft +19, Swim +9
Languages Abyssal, Aquan, Common, Draconic, Sahaugin
SQ arcane bond (hand of glory), life sight (10 rounds/day)
Gear potion of cure serious wounds, potion of water breathing, wand of dispel magic; Other Gear cloak of resistance +2, headband of vast intelligence +4, ring of swimming, hand of glory, spell component pouch, spellbook.
